title: Noughts and Crosses

sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: two single or multi-message switches record: "next" on one switch "there" on the other

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. Draw a noughts and crosses grid.
2. On the switch user's turn, point to the first empty square.
3. If they presses "next", move to the next empty square. If they press "there", place their mark in that square.
4. Keep playing until a player wins with 3 marks in a row!

tooltipText: Use 2 switches for NOUGHTS AND CROSSES
